gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-oriya: Stentiga draws every stroke with the same pipe-like thickness, crossbars included, which gives it a smooth, luxurious look. gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-pahawh-: Stentiga spreads its letters out with wide-open gaps and a single-depth, engraved feel to every stroke. But Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, a sans-serif with a high-set x-height, would look lost if the heading shrank small.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-pau-cin: Noto Sans Pau Cin Hau reads open and modern, its curves leaving real room. Over many paragraphs it stays easy on the eye, a plain sans with a short step up to capitals, while Stentiga's marker-round tips handle the headline.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-phagspa: Spacious, polished, a little luxurious. Noto Sans PhagsPa keeps its c openings see-through and nudges gently up to capitals, so a long page of sans text moves along comfortably under Stentiga's round-rimmed headings.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-phoenic: Stentiga looks refined and spread out, its strokes bent like steel rod and its openings wide as a door left ajar. Noto Sans Phoenician follows with generous lowercase height, so sans text flows easily.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Stentiga spaces itself out with luxury and refinement. Noto Sans Rejang follows with portholes of counters and open gaps in its c, e, s and a, so a plain sans paragraph keeps breathing through many lines.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays down a dense, dark band of lowercase in every line, with curve endings that never crowd. Stentiga, with its pipe-like strokes and spread-out tracking, lifts that plain sans texture above it.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Stentiga's curves meet its stems exactly, giving a refined, spaced-out look with crossbars as sturdy as the verticals. Noto Sans Sunuwar, a sans-serif with short ascenders, can stay at a modest size.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-noto-sans-syloti-: Noto Sans Syloti Nagri keeps short ascenders and a lofty x-height, with an a whose lower bowl opens to breathe. Shrink Stentiga's heading and its thick joins and wide tracking lose their spark.
